source_name: Fővárosi Törvényszék judgments published as KDB case attachments
why_relevant: The Fővárosi Törvényszék has exclusive jurisdiction over judicial review of KDB decisions; its judgments are mirrored as attachments on the KDB site under a predictable attachment path with case numbers such as 103.K.704.694/2024/10 linked to D.634/2024. Judgments often restate bid prices and evaluation detail and show whether an award was ultimately annulled.

source_name: MNB recommendation 7/2020 on use of external service providers (outsourcing) + MNB institution search
why_relevant: Transposes EBA/GL/2019/02 and obliges Hungarian institutions to maintain a documented outsourcing register recording the external provider's identity, company registration number, tax number, seat, contacts AND THE PARENT COMPANY NAME, plus criticality. This is the regulatory hook that makes intra-group and cross-border sourcing arrangements documentable and, in part, discoverable via supervisory disclosures and banks' own business rules (üzletszabályzat), which must list outsourced activities and their performers.

source_name: MNB recommendation 1/2025 and 13/2025 on IT systems / banking digitalisation
why_relevant: MNB requires institutions to regulate IT governance, planning, development AND PROCUREMENT ('beszerzés'), operations and independent control. These recommendations shape what group-level platform rollouts must satisfy locally, and are the vocabulary source for Hungarian procurement/IT terms used in bank filings.

source_name: Nemzeti Jogszabálytár / Jogtár – 194/2025. (VII. 8.) Korm. rendelet az önkormányzati számlavezetés részletszabályairól
why_relevant: The legal instrument governing whether and how a municipality may keep a commercial-bank account at all. Any amendment resets the addressable market and the tender pipeline for municipal account services; also useful for defining exactly which bodies remain free to tender.

source_name: Korm. rendelet 373/2022. (IX. 30.) on the implementation of Hungary's RRP (net.jogtar.hu)
why_relevant: Legal basis naming the responsible institutions and the procurement-control regime for RRF-funded contracts in Hungary (incl. the role of NFK in vetting procurement procedures). Defines which bodies act as contracting authorities — the entity list to filter TED on.

source_name: 499/2022. (XII. 8.) Korm. rendelet — detailed rules of the Central Information Public Data Registry (Nemzeti Jogszabálytár)
why_relevant: Defines exactly which contract fields must be published, by whom, and with what exemptions (defence, classified, and — contested — bank secrecy). Essential to interpret gaps in the registry rather than mistaking them for absence of deals.

source_name: K&H Csoport fenntarthatósági irányelvek (sustainability policy, incl. responsible procurement)
why_relevant: Closest thing found to a public K&H (KBC group) procurement policy: describes the CSR declaration built into all supplier contracts since 2010 (ethics, environment, anti-corruption, human rights) and KBC group blacklist constraints on counterparties. K&H publishes no supplier portal, so this document is the primary public window on its vendor requirements.

entity_name: BÉT / Budapest Stock Exchange disclosure archive
source_name: Erste Bank Hungary base prospectus / BÉT (bet.hu) issuer filings
why_relevant: Hungarian subsidiary issuer documents describe group affiliation, intra-group service arrangements and material outsourcing/dependency on the Austrian parent — a way to reveal group-level sourcing dependencies that are never announced as tenders.

source_name: GVH ágazati vizsgálat – bankkártya-elfogadási piac jelentés (2019 sector inquiry)
why_relevant: Sector inquiry report into the Hungarian card-acceptance market: acquirer shares, merchant fee structures, terminal deployment. Directly relevant background for interpreting acquiring/POS tenders and for identifying the acquirer set that bids on public contracts.

source_name: MBH Bank Nyrt. – Etikai Kódex (Code of Ethics, procurement chapter)
why_relevant: MBH publishes no supplier portal; its Code of Ethics is the only located public statement of sourcing conduct, confirming that larger purchases run through a bidding process (pályáztatás) and setting impartiality rules for staff dealing with vendors. Establishes that competitive RFx exists at MBH even though it is never publicly advertised.

source_name: eForms SDK documentation (OP-TED)
why_relevant: Defines the eForms schema, field IDs and codelists now used for all Hungarian notices sent to TED. Needed to parse notices correctly (lot structure, CPV, estimated value, award winner, framework agreement flags) and to build stable extraction rules.

source_name: Erste Bank Hungary — Fenntartható és etikus beszállítói lánc (sustainable/ethical supplier chain)
why_relevant: Hungarian-language confirmation that a group procurement unit is the EXCLUSIVE procurement service provider for Erste Bank Hungary and its subsidiaries, that tenders run on the Erste Group Procurement online platform, and it discloses supplier-base metrics (c. 2,230 Hungarian suppliers, 105 major partners). Directly evidences the cell hypothesis that Hungarian bank spend is decided on a group platform.

source_name: EKR user manual (Felhasználói Kézikönyv) - PDF
why_relevant: Documents EKR's data model, notice types, search fields and identifiers (EKR eljárásazonosító). Essential engineering reference for designing a reliable EKR collector and for mapping HU notice-type names to a normalised schema.

source_name: RBI Group Supplier Code of Conduct — Hungarian version (PDF)
why_relevant: Group-issued, Hungarian-language supplier rulebook applying to all RBI suppliers delivering goods, services or licences — the compliance gate any vendor to Raiffeisen Bank Zrt. must pass. Its existence in Hungarian shows group-level terms being pushed down to the Hungarian subsidiary.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Zrt. – Áruk és szolgáltatások beszerzésének általános feltételei (procurement GTC, PDF)
why_relevant: Published general terms and conditions governing Raiffeisen Bank Zrt. and its subsidiaries' purchases of goods and services — the contractual framework any supplier is held to. One of the few Hungarian bank procurement documents published as a standalone public PDF.

source_name: Hungarian business/economic press on foreign bank groups' Hungary strategy (e.g. Telex gazdaság)
why_relevant: Hungarian-language reporting on whether foreign-owned groups (Erste, UniCredit, CIB/Intesa, Raiffeisen, K&H) stay or exit the market is a leading indicator of whether group-level investment and platform rollouts will be extended to or withdrawn from the Hungarian subsidiary.

source_name: Tender Help Hungary - EKR/procurement explainer (EN+HU)
why_relevant: Bilingual practitioner explainer of EKR mechanics, notice types and tendering interfaces. Useful for building the HU/EN glossary and understanding how to navigate EKR search — not a data source itself.

source_name: bankweb.hu – IIR Kártyapiac conference coverage
why_relevant: Trade-press coverage of the card-market conference that describes the participant profile (banks, card service providers, fintechs, telcos, cafeteria-card issuers, government agencies). Useful for reconstructing attendee/vendor composition when organiser sponsor pages are archived away.

source_name: Broadcom/Symantec customer case study archive (Budapest Bank example)
why_relevant: Demonstrates that security/fraud vendors publish named Hungarian bank case studies (Budapest Bank) as PDFs on documentation CDNs rather than in newsrooms — an easily missed disclosure surface for fraud/security deals.

entity_name: CEE banking sector M&A / market studies and CEE Legal Matters guides
source_name: CEE banking sector M&A / market studies and CEE Legal Matters guides
why_relevant: CEE-wide legal and M&A studies map which groups own which Hungarian banks and how regional consolidation is moving — the ownership layer that determines where a Hungarian bank's procurement authority actually sits, and which regional frameworks a Hungarian entity is likely to be pulled into.

source_name: FISAC CGIL — UniCredit Services procurement reorganisation reporting (Italian trade union)
why_relevant: Italian union sources report internal UniCredit procurement reorganisation and tooling in detail — e.g. the move of supplier tendering and qualification from legacy modules (GSD, Agorà) onto SAP Ariba, and who operates it. UniCredit Bank Hungary's vendor selection sits inside exactly this group machinery, which UniCredit itself does not disclose publicly.

source_name: Nemzeti Útdíjfizetési Szolgáltató – VPOS 2025/2026 tender documentation (worked example)
why_relevant: Concrete, recent example of a Hungarian state company procuring virtual POS / online card acceptance (EKR001432572025). Shows the document pattern, CPV codes and requirement language to template future payments-tender detection; also shows contracting authorities publish tender docs on their own sites in parallel with EKR.

source_name: NJSZT iTF Adattár – institutional history of Hungarian IT associations
why_relevant: The Neumann Society's IT-history archive documents Hungarian IT trade bodies and companies over decades, including predecessor names and mergers. Valuable for resolving legacy vendor names appearing in older award notices and for tracing corporate lineage.

entity_name: NKE / academic analyses of KDB procedure and procurement litigation
source_name: NKE / academic analyses of KDB procedure and procurement litigation
why_relevant: Monograph-grade description of KDB procedure and procurement litigation, plus doctoral work on EU-funded procurement irregularities. Best for calibrating how to read decisions, deadlines, standing and the appeal chain — i.e. collection design rather than content.

entity_name: Procurement vendor case studies on RBI
source_name: Procurement vendor case studies on RBI (akirolabs, CPOstrategy)
why_relevant: Vendor-published case studies and CPO interviews reveal, in the vendor's own words, which procurement/category-management platforms a CEE banking group adopted and how centralised sourcing is organised across subsidiaries — a rare window into decisions never tendered publicly.

source_name: Red Flags (redflags.eu) - K-Monitor / Transparency International Hungary / PetaByte
why_relevant: Algorithmic risk-flagging of Hungarian procurement notices; useful for spotting single-bidder, tailored-spec or rushed banking/payments tenders. Reported as not updated since 27 October 2023 due to TED data-source changes — valuable as a historical corpus and methodology reference rather than a live feed.

entity_name: Visa acceptance-entity / payment facilitator model documentation
source_name: Visa acceptance-entity / payment facilitator model documentation
why_relevant: Defines the scheme's acceptance-entity taxonomy (acquirer, PayFac, marketplace, sponsored merchant, ISO) that structures how HU acquiring deals are contracted; needed to classify Hungarian actors correctly and to interpret tender requirement language.
